other_conditions: The construction worker must be registered under the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board.
Spouse and children of the registered construction worker are also eligible for assistance.
The applicant must be hospitalized for at least five continuous days to qualify for the benefit.
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per day for the first five days of hospitalization, then ₹500 per day for the next ten days (up to 15 days total).
